Cost: 1 holy pool point

Benefit: As a standard action, the paladin can strike down an enemy with a melee attack of holy lightning. If successful, she deals an extra 1d6 damage (half holy, half lightning) to the enemy plus an extra 1d6 damage per four holy knight levels. An enemy hit by goring blade takes the paladin's Charisma modifier in damage the next round. A successful Fortitude save (DC 10 + half of the paladin's level + her Charisma modifier) negates the bonus damage from Charisma.
